event_description: State disaster proclamation for 38 counties after heavy rain caused flash flooding and record river flooding (later expanded to 44 counties).
Gubernatorial disaster proclamation for Champaign, Grundy, LaSalle, Massac, Tazewell, Washington and Woodford counties after severe storms with tornadoes and straight-line winds.
State disaster proclamation for 23 counties after June and July storms with heavy rainfall, flash and river flooding, tornadoes and straight-line winds.
State disaster proclamation for Calhoun, Jackson, Jersey, Madison, Monroe, Randolph and St. Clair counties for flooding.
State disaster proclamation for Kane, McHenry and Lake counties (Cook County added July 16) for flooding on the Des Plaines and Fox rivers after heavy rainfall.
State disaster proclamation for flooding in 34 counties along the Mississippi and Illinois rivers after heavy rainfall (renewed May 31, June 28 and July 29, 2019).
State disaster proclamation for 28 counties after tornadoes and high winds on December 10, 2021, including the Edwardsville warehouse collapse in Madison County.
State disaster proclamation for St. Clair and Washington counties after severe weather, torrential rain and flash flooding on July 25 and 27, 2022.
